Sure thing! I posted my Space Bucket build here for anyone who's interested.

This particular plant is now 16 days into flowering, and I'm going to keep it in flower until ~40 days, or until the buds are done, whichever comes first. This is my first grow so I'm still unsure of what the future holds :)

I'm using 5 daylight CFL bulbs, 1600 lumens each for 8000 lumens total.

I'm using a soil blend of 70% Fox Farms Happy Frog / 30% Perlite, which drains well and allows for light watering (minimal runoff) every other day or so.

I water with nutrients every watering, which is good or bad depending on who you ask. I usually use about 1/8 to 1/6 of the half-gallon container per watering (about 2-4 waterings per batch). I'm using the Fox Farms basic three nutrient pack - Grow Big, Big Bloom, Tiger Bloom. I use a half-gallon milk container so I just cut the recommended measurements in half, right now the mix calls for 1.5tsp of Big Bloom, 1tsp of Grow Big, and 1tsp of Tiger Bloom. The hardest part is getting the pH level correct, and cleaning up spills :)

The veg period for this plant was 25 days. I got it as a starter plant when it was 10 days old already, and I've been using LST and HST methods to control the growth, including lightly snapping the branches to form a knuckle and increase the flow of nutrients to that branch, defoliation, and a SCROG.
